### PE_T1_01 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), identify the French anatomist who defined 21 primary tissue types without microscopic aid:

- A) Xavier Bichat
- B) Marcello Malpighi
- C) Robert Hooke
- D) Anton van Leeuwenhoek

> **✅ Answer:** A) Xavier Bichat
> **Explanation:** Xavier Bichat coined the term tissue and defined 21 primary tissue classes.

### PE_T1_02 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), microscopic investigation of animal tissues was systematically pioneered by which biologist?

- A) Xavier Bichat
- B) Marcello Malpighi
- C) Theodor Schwann
- D) Rudolf Virchow

> **✅ Answer:** B) Marcello Malpighi
> **Explanation:** Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic histology.

### PE_T1_03 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), true tissue level of organization first evolved in which invertebrate phylum?

- A) Porifera
- B) Coelenterata (Cnidaria)
- C) Platyhelminthes
- D) Annelida

> **✅ Answer:** B) Coelenterata (Cnidaria)
> **Explanation:** Tissue grade organization originated in Coelenterates (Hydra).

### PE_T1_04 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), embryonic mesoderm gives origin to which pair of primary tissues?

- A) Epithelial and Nervous
- B) Connective and Muscular
- C) Epithelial and Muscular
- D) Connective and Nervous

> **✅ Answer:** B) Connective and Muscular
> **Explanation:** Connective tissue and muscle arise from embryonic mesoderm.

### PE_T1_05 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), which primary tissue type originates from all three germ layers (Ectoderm, Mesoderm, Endoderm)?

- A) Muscular Tissue
- B) Nervous Tissue
- C) Epithelial Tissue
- D) Connective Tissue

> **✅ Answer:** C) Epithelial Tissue
> **Explanation:** Epithelia derive from ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm.

### PE_T1_06 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), the non-cellular basement membrane underlying epithelial sheets contains basal lamina and:

- A) Reticular lamina
- B) Hydroxyapatite matrix
- C) Elastic lamellae
- D) Ossein canals

> **✅ Answer:** A) Reticular lamina
> **Explanation:** Basement membrane = Basal lamina + Reticular lamina.

### PE_T1_07 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1), avascular epithelial sheets obtain metabolic nutrients primarily via:

- A) Direct intra-epithelial capillary blood flow
- B) Simple diffusion from underlying connective tissue blood vessels
- C) Active transport from lumen air space
- D) Perichondrial canaliculi

> **✅ Answer:** B) Simple diffusion from underlying connective tissue blood vessels
> **Explanation:** Epithelial cells depend on nutrient diffusion across the basement membrane.

### PE_T1_08 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all historical milestones established in animal histology: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Xavier Bichat defined 21 primary tissue types without microscope
- [ ] B) Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic tissue investigation
- [ ] C) Mayer coined the term 'Histology' in 1819
- [ ] D) True tissue level first evolved in Phylum Coelenterata
- [ ] E) Leeuwenhoek discovered Haversian osteons

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Xavier Bichat defined 21 primary tissue types without microscope, B) Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic tissue investigation, C) Mayer coined the term 'Histology' in 1819, D) True tissue level first evolved in Phylum Coelenterata
> **Explanation:** Bichat, Malpighi, Mayer, and Coelenterate evolution represent foundational histology milestones.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_T1_09 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all primary tissue classes in complex animals: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Epithelial Tissue
- [ ] B) Connective Tissue
- [ ] C) Muscular Tissue
- [ ] D) Nervous Tissue
- [ ] E) Vascular Tissue as fifth primary class

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Epithelial Tissue, B) Connective Tissue, C) Muscular Tissue, D) Nervous Tissue
> **Explanation:** 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

### PE_T1_10 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all embryonic germ layers giving rise to Epithelial Tissues: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Ectoderm (Skin epidermis)
- [ ] B) Mesoderm (Endothelium & Mesothelium)
- [ ] C) Endoderm (GI mucosa)
- [ ] D) Neural crest only
- [ ] E) Blastoderm only

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Ectoderm (Skin epidermis), B) Mesoderm (Endothelium & Mesothelium), C) Endoderm (GI mucosa)
> **Explanation:** Epithelium arises from Ectoderm, Mesoderm, and Endoderm.
